title: HELIOS — Orbital Foundry
backend: Native WebGPU with automatic WebGL2/WebGL1 fallback; WebGPU and forced WebGL2 verified in Chrome
techniques: Analytic sphere intersection and 20–64-step fragment-shader plasma volume integration
Animated magnetic gimbals, four lights and directional PCF shadows
CPU billboard particles, HDR bloom, ACES and FXAA
Adaptive 50–100% CSS resolution with manual override
limitations: Wall-frame timing, not GPU timestamp timing
Particles are CPU simulated; no compute or hardware ray tracing
Reflections use a static generated cubemap, not live scene reflections
Triangle estimate excludes shadow, particle and post-processing passes
Work is capped; minimum resolution does not guarantee frame rate
TryCloudflare URL is temporary and requires running local sessions
Observed frame rates on a shared machine are not controlled benchmark results

Resize to 1200x800 CSS produced 2400x1600; live DPR 1.5 produced 2160x1440. Zero console/page errors in combined native HiDPI regression. Evidence: artifacts/exhibition-tests.json; original-fixed100.png. Earlier reactor WebGL2 fallback and interaction checks passed in artifacts/test.log. Static production artifacts passed under /eval-gpu/babylon/: both scene links, native WebGPU and forced WebGL2, native DPR 2 at default/max, route/night controls, all assets including compiler WASM inside prefix, zero request/HTTP/console/page errors.
